facts.fact: The GSMA report states that the Ministry of Information and Digitalisation, supported by UNDP and other partners, published the draft Malawi National Digital Transformation Strategy and a 5-year roadmap for consultation in February 2026; the report does not name who outside government took part.
facts.system: Malawi National Digital Transformation Strategy and 5-year roadmap

note: Only the February 2026 draft strategy put out for consultation is a fact; no published report of comments, no required-consultation rule and no standing body are stated; the 2024 energy-project stakeholder engagement document is not digital.
